findings.reason: #8c8c8c on #ffffff measures 3.36:1 for ordinary text (4.5:1 AA). Affects 1 element(s).
findings.suggestion: Darken the text or lighten the background to reach at least 4.5:1; the baseline target is 7:1.

findings.title: Median 135 characters per line is outside 50–75
findings.reason: Measured from rendered line boxes (10th–90th percentile 129–137.1, 10 lines). 50–75 is a starting range, not an accessibility limit or proven optimum. For a fixed improvement from changing line length: No reliable quantitative improvement established.
findings.suggestion: Consider constraining the column (max-width) so typical lines fall near 60–70 characters, and verify the rendered result.

findings.title: Body text is 15px, below 16px
findings.reason: Nominal size from computed styles. Apparent size also depends on the font's x-height and viewing distance, which this tool does not measure. For a transferable gain from a specific size change: No reliable quantitative improvement established.
findings.suggestion: Consider 18px for long-form body text, and make sure enlargement remains available.

findings.title: Line height 1.3 is outside 1.4–1.7
findings.reason: Ratio of measured baseline distance to font size. This is a starting range, not a requirement. No reliable quantitative improvement established.
findings.suggestion: Consider 1.5 as a conservative starting point.

findings.title: Paragraph gap is 0.27× text size
findings.reason: The extra gap between paragraphs is outside the heuristic 0.5–1× range (values up to 2× are tolerated before reporting). A heuristic only.
findings.suggestion: About 0.75× text size separates ideas without fragmenting them.

findings.title: No content loss detected under WCAG 1.4.12 text spacing
findings.reason: Checked hidden text, spilled text and horizontal scrolling after applying line-height 1.5, paragraph spacing 2em, letter spacing 0.12em and word spacing 0.16em (document and open shadow roots). Loss of functionality other than hidden text (e.g. broken interactions) is not detected automatically.

findings.title: About 28 more characters become hidden under 320 CSS px reflow
findings.reason: 0 characters hidden at baseline, 28 after rendering at a 320×256 CSS px viewport. Text is lost in a real browser test.
findings.suggestion: Avoid fixed heights and overflow: hidden on text containers; let boxes grow with their content.

findings.title: Element needs horizontal scrolling (possible 2D-content exception)
findings.reason: Tables, code, images and similar content may legitimately need two-dimensional layout under WCAG 1.4.10. Confirm this element qualifies; prose around it must still reflow.
findings.suggestion: Wrap the element in a container with overflow-x: auto so only it scrolls.
